title: One of the five men arrested near RAF Fairford called 999 himself
description: He made the call almost an hour before a farmer also called police after seeing men in balaclavas.

title: How did the RAF Fairford incident go from 'suspected bomb plot' to police bail?
description: Detectives are entering a vital stage of the investigation, with a number of options still open, the BBC's Daniel Sandford writes.

title: Burnham vows to end existing pension triple lock in 2030 to help fund care
description: The PM was at times emotional during his conference speech in which he outlined his long-term plan for the UK.

title: Chris Mason: Burnham delivers deeply political speech with a personal core
description: The key thing to understand about Andy Burnham's speech is these were the words and the delivery of both a new prime minister and a grieving son, the BBC's political editor writes.

title: Household energy bills forecast to see biggest rise in four years
description: A typical household faces an annual gas and electricity bill of £1,999 from January, based on a key forecast.

title: Three teenagers die after car enters River Wear
description: The bodies of two teenage boys and a teenage girl have been recovered from the water, police say.

title: Man City guilty of 'sham' contracts and misleading accounts
description: The Premier League confirms that Manchester City have been found guilty of all charges related to breaches of Premier League financial rules between 2009-10 and 2017-18.

title: Antisemitism on the rise at universities, charity warns
description: The Community Security Trust says reported incidents are "substantially higher" than before the war in Gaza began.

title: It is time for Tuchel to offer Alexander-Arnold some trust
description: Having been overlooked for so long, Trent Alexander-Arnold produced a world-class moment on his return, writes Phil McNulty.
